title: Performance Monitoring
description: Firebase Performance Monitoring helpers for web and @react-native-firebase/perf on native.

markers.block:
['@react-native-firebase/app', { ios: { disableSPM: true } }],
    ['expo-build-properties', { ios: { useFrameworks: 'static', forceStaticLinking: ['RNFBApp', 'RNFBAnalytics', 'RNFBRemoteConfig', 'RNFBCrashlytics', 'RNFBPerf', 'RNFBAppCheck', 'RNFBFirestore', 'RNFBAuth', 'RNFBMessaging'] } }],

notes: iOS uses CocoaPods Firebase (disableSPM) with static frameworks — required on Xcode 26+; SPM + dynamic hits SwiftUICore linker errors.
